a.lede: Compromise of 3 domain registries allows hackers to walk off with unauthorized certs.
a.title: Hackers obtain counterfeit TLS certificates for Google and other large services

b.lede: Hackers obtained unauthorized HTTPS certificates for several Google domains and hijacked domains in the country-code top-level domains (ccTLDs) for Ghana, American Samoa, and Sierra Leone after compromising third-party operators and modifying authoritative DNS records. [...]
b.title: Hackers hijack Google domains after breaching ccTLD registries
